# P05 execution checkpoint

Recovery inspection verified all seven P05 files exist. The previous worker timed out after writing a passing report; its checkpoint was stale. The current approved plan and review remain controlling. Scope is MC13–MC18 and MC28, with wider G4/G5/G14/G18 obligations retained.

Evidence contract: implement economic inputs → committed state/journals → all statements. Comparator: protected Northstar postings/expected statements; independent journal replay, economic perturbations and checker mutations. Pass requires matching H1/H2/FY/fixed/floating statements, all bridge identities, atomic rejection and distinct default/unsupported results, information enforcement, retained branch mass and conditional Apple source mapping. Leakage, hash mismatch, absent checks, non-atomic changes or unexplained differences veto acceptance. Counts and successful execution are explanatory, never accounting/forecast validity.

Skeptical audit passed: separate economic inputs prevent replaying expected postings; arithmetic balance is only an engineering invariant; derivative notional never identifies exposure; stress does not reweight histories; no stochastic ranking or empirical forecast claim; CPU-only standard-library execution plus existing prerequisite Z3; failure stops the affected path and retains its last committed state.

Defaults audit: half-year aggregate ordering, homogeneous cost-5 inventory, end-period capex, straight-line cohorts, 20% simple tax, zero OCI and no borrowing come from Northstar's synthetic specification. They are bounded baseline conventions, not company-general defaults. Risks: hidden chronology, omitted treatments and unknown real exposure. Early checks: cash/inventory feasibility, schedules, input mutation and unsupported operations. Exact rational arithmetic is an engineering choice; no currency-rounding or arbitrary-calendar claim.

Declared files: scripts/company_execution_v1.py; scripts/check_accounting_p05.py; docs/design/fixt
